csv_project_name: Architectural & Engineering for Miller Valley Road Sidewalk
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Prescott may be seeking a consultant to provide a Architectural & Engineering service for Miller Valley Road Sidewalk Replacement. The project generally consists of sidewalk and sidewalk ramp improvements along Miller Valley Road and Grove Avenue between Whipple Street and Gurley Street. The primary scope of work is to remove and replace sidewalk and sidewalk ramps that are not accessible with a mobility device or are not ADA compliant. Work includes the removal and replacement of sidewalk, sidewalk ramps, driveway entrances, and curb and gutter. Other improvements may include an ADA compliant sidewalk on the east side of Grove Avenue at Lincoln Avenue, roadway improvements to provide space for a sidewalk on the west side of Grove Avenue between Elrod Road and Garden Street, work to provide ADA compliant roadway crossings, pedestrian signage and roadway markings, and the relocation/removal of overhead utility and street light poles encroaching into sidewalks and sidewalk ramps. Because of the scale of the project the City plans to design and construct the improvements in phases.
csv_disciplines_requested: Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering
